label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Subject:** Nia's hen

Bethan,

I'm not having a go, I promise. I know things with Lowri have been awful and I'm not asking you to pretend they haven't. But before you finalise this, can I say a few things?

Nia rang me crying last week asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out, and I don't know how to be the one who tells her. You sat with her at the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. She hasn't forgotten that and nor have I.

I've also done a fair bit to make this work. I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work so I could have the hen weekend off, and it cost me a night stop I really wanted. I'm not saying that to guilt you, I just want you to know I'm not treating it as small.

You've got your reading at Margam on the 17th, which is the bit Nia's been most excited about. Nobody's asking you to be in the cottage all weekend.

What I'm asking is much smaller. Skip the cottage Friday if you want. Just come for Saturday. The meal's at Caffi Harbwr at half seven, so you'd only need to be in Tenby for the evening. I'll pick you up from Cardiff Central, it's about two and a half hours on the train, and you can kip in with me. I've got the twin room, so you'd have your own bed. In and out, and you don't have to spend the whole time with anyone you don't want to.

And please don't send Lowri the £85 yet. Sit on it for a few days and see how you feel.

I'm not going to lecture you. For what it's worth, I think Lowri's sorry really, she's just as stubborn as you are. I just think you'd regret missing it, and Nia will remember who was there and who wasn't.

Think about it, and text me if you want to talk it through.

Love,
Siân

reasons: It omits the 6 pm arrival time and the acknowledgment that both said things at Lowri's 40th, and incorrectly offers pickup from Cardiff Central rather than the Tenby station.
